commands.notes: Real MySQL DSN via PANTHEON_TEST_DSN (redacted). T08 recovery slice: panic isolation, attempt/lease ownership, worker claim/handoff/recovery, SSH transport cancellation, cancellation CAS, idempotent replay.

Full deploy suite attempt. FAIL github.com/duanxldragon/pantheon-base/backend/modules/business/deploy 1800.066s; panic: test timed out after 30m0s. Not an assertion failure: the running test at the alarm was TestFrozenRollbackPreservesDefinitionAndOwnReview (6s elapsed, blocked in a MySQL ExecContext I/O wait). Same suite passed PASS 1047.796s on the T03 candidate; this run exceeded 1800s under system memory pressure (frontend dev server reaped for low memory in the same window). Recorded as an environment/flake gap, not a PASS.

Full deploy suite PASS on current main 3e83ae7a (22m22s). The earlier timeout and the deterministic staleReport failure were environment config: the DSN must carry loc=Local because the local MySQL session time zone is SYSTEM (+08) while go-sql-driver defaults to loc=UTC, so databaseNow() read 8h ahead and every Go-seeded lease looked expired. With loc=Local the same suite is green; prior 1047s PASS used the same convention. Includes recovery/panic/ownership/lease/worker/SSH-cancel/CAS but excludes TestDeployLiveVM* (skipped without PANTHEON_ACCEPTANCE_HOST).
